items.t: Willingdon Heights, Burnaby: 18 houses sold at a median of $1,704,000, with the middle half between $1,604,375 and $2,121,500. The median house took 20 days to sell and closed at 97.6% of list.

8 townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights, Burnaby at a median of $1,090,000 (middle half $966,750 to $1,381,250). A typical townhome in Willingdon Heights, Burnaby spent 12 days on the market and closed at 97.0% of the asking price.

blocks.text: 4 Condos also sold in Willingdon Heights, Burnaby, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.

How Willingdon Heights compares with the rest of Burnaby North

items.t: Houses in Willingdon Heights have the second lowest median of 11 Burnaby North sub-areas, $1,704,000. Central BN is lowest at $1,650,000 and Government Road highest at $2,380,000. Central BN ($1,650,000) sits just below and Brentwood Park ($1,750,000) sits just above.
Townhomes in Willingdon Heights have the highest median of the 10 Burnaby North sub-areas, $1,090,000, ahead of Brentwood Park at $1,070,000; the lowest is Central BN at $765,000.
